notes: Cash basis. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); the statement rolls fund balances (beginning 918,570, ending 1,014,236), recorded as fund balance; beginning cash is not printed (null); ending cash = all printed governmental cash lines (cash and cash equivalents, cash with County Treasurer, restricted cash; p3); fund balance differs from cash by due from/to other funds. No transfers are printed for FY2022. Sales and other taxes 212,622 is sales tax: the budget schedule p7 prints Sales taxes 212,622, equal to this line and to the sum of the p8 department/fund cells. Property taxes 281,325 equals budget-schedule property taxes-county 259,475 + motor vehicle taxes-county 21,850 (p7) but is printed as property taxes, kept as printed (as in FY2023). Business-type: proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Cash Basis (p6) Total column, measure cash. Detail: governmental funds from the p8 combining schedule (General Fund department columns plus Street, Dump, Keno, Golf Course, Pool; the Street column's Federal receipts cell prints 0, not recorded); business-type detail from the proprietary statement fund columns p6 (Water, Sewer, Electric); the p7 budget-to-actual schedule (all funds combined) is not recorded. The p9 County Treasurer's fund schedule (pass-through of levies to the city) is not recorded. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p3; totals equal the government-wide governmental column), business-type and eliminations from the Statement of Net Position (p1).
